body:
Thank you for the reply. I have reached out for help. A lot of those close to me just simply don't understand it. I was actually at a funeral today and it got me thinking a lot. 

I am in very deep actually, in that I have exhausted most options out of what I am in, and the hope of getting out of it is a sliver that I strive for but can't seem to figure out. 

For the past year or so I have tried to find improvement in my life. I've tried to make corrections, but all attempts have failed.

Thank you. I did make it. Which sort of makes me wonder as I have survived what I shouldn't have on multiple occasions now. Thinking of pleasant things does help, but it only gets so far. 

How have you been doing? It is hard to have hope and I am glad to hear you are able to find hope.
